LanguageData.EA_Enabled_Desc: Master switch. When off the mod does nothing beyond a single check per drawn pawn.
LanguageData.EA_Eating_Desc: Spoon or fork bites carrying the real food when eating at a table; hunched hand-to-mouth eating of the real food item when eating without one.
LanguageData.EA_Cooking_Desc: Stirring a frying pan (meals) or pot, tossing the bill's real ingredients in while the real product forms as work progresses. Steam included.
LanguageData.EA_Butchering_Desc: Cleaver chops; chunks of the carcass's own meat fly off on impact.
LanguageData.EA_Crafting_Desc: Hammering (with sparks at smithies), sewing, chiselling sculptures and grinding drugs, with the real product taking shape on the bench.
LanguageData.EA_Work_Desc: Construction, deconstruction (sawing), mining, sowing and harvesting, cleaning and research. Tending and surgery stay vanilla. Also covers modded jobs through their skill.
LanguageData.EA_Games_Desc: Moving board-game pieces, holding and dealing cards, winding up throws.
LanguageData.EA_Reading_Desc: Pages turning over the real book, newspaper or document being read, including ones from other mods.
LanguageData.EA_Apparel_Desc: The pawn wiggles into the real garment as it comes down over them, or out of it as it comes off.
LanguageData.EA_Equip_Desc: A quick hop and twirl of the real weapon after equipping it.
LanguageData.EA_Animals_Desc: Head-down grazing bob for non-humanlike pawns while they eat.
LanguageData.EA_Props_Desc: Draw utensils, tools, ingredients, products, pages and effects. Turn off to keep only body motion.
LanguageData.EA_HideZoomed: Hide held items when zoomed far out
LanguageData.EA_HideZoomed_Desc: Skips drawing props at the zoom level where the game itself switches pawns to cached low-detail rendering.
LanguageData.EA_Intensity_Desc: Scales how far pawns lean, bob and nod.
